name: Cross-tenant data exposure and edit on PartnerServiceAdd page
description:
Steps to reproduce

1. Log into any project as any non-superadmin admin (a plain "manager"-role user).
2. Find a services row owned by a different project (any addon another tenant has installed).
3. Navigate to /admin/pridat-partnerskou-sluzbu/?id=<that other tenant's service id>.

Current
The edit form renders in full with the other tenant's real data — OAuth callback URL, webhook URLs, install settings — and both Uložit / Uložit a odejít are present and functional. No 403, no 404. Confirmed with 3 independent fresh logins; this is a genuine cross-tenant IDOR, not a caching artifact. Very likely already live on production master (an unrelated schema-validation quirk on the pre-rewrite page happened to mask it as a generic crash instead of a visible leak).

Expected
Opening another tenant's service id returns a real 404/error with no data from that tenant anywhere in the response (page body, Smarty vars, or Inertia props).

Technical notes

▎ Generated by Claude Sonnet 5, on 2026-09-17

- Root cause is in admin/controllers/PartnerServiceController.php — the shared base for PartnerServiceAddController and its siblings — which sets a displayPage404 flag instead of throwing on a failed ownership check, so the page action still runs and builds the leaked payload.
- Fix identified and already applied on a scratch worktree (not yet on any branch/PR): swap the flag assignment for throw new PageNotFound(), matching how every sibling controller in the same family already handles this.
- Affects all actions routed through this base class (PartnerServiceAddController, PartnerServiceInstallController, PartnerServiceSubmitController, PartnerServiceShippingServiceDetailController, PartnerServiceEndPointModifyController) — confirmed the same fix blocks both the legacy Smarty render and the newer Inertia/React render, since the check runs before either path builds output.
- Owning area: admin partner/addon controllers (API-partner integration family).
